frontmatter.title: Missing Function Level Access Control: The Silent Authorization Gap in Modern APIs
frontmatter.subheading: Why checking who can log in is never the same as checking who can act - and how attackers exploit the difference
frontmatter.excerpt: A deep technical guide to Missing Function Level Access Control (MFLAC): what it is, how attackers exploit it, why it persists, and how to design authorization that actually holds.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
